title: Lane Keeping Alerts and Intervention
summary: Feedback on lane departure warning and lane keeping centers on overly sensitive alerts and intrusive steering intervention, with a few comments praising lane-centering performance but many fragments lacking clear evaluative sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review compares the lane keeping system favorably enough to note it as a recognizable driver-assistance feature, though detail is limited.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe lane keeping and departure warnings as overly sensitive, inaccurate, annoying, or too forceful, including false warnings and intervention that hinders lane changes.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the alerts are only a minor issue but still criticizes them for appearing too often and seeming predictive rather than responsive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention lane keeping precision, appreciation of the feature, adjustment guidance, and some unclear or off-topic references, so sentiment cannot be assigned consistently from the sampled text alone.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are undetermined or truncated, which limits confidence in summarizing clear sentiment beyond the explicit negative examples.
This topic includes at least one fragment that appears unrelated or too ambiguous to interpret as lane-keeping feedback.
The samples are stratified and not representative of all owners or of broader vehicle performance.
